text:
Ivy (People Ops): Rafael submitted a hotel stay but disputes a $27 minibar charge that he says he didn’t incur. The folio shows the charge but he says room was never used after check-in. What evidence do we need to resolve?
Rafael: I checked out early and left the door locked. I have the hotel key return receipt and a photo of the room door closed at 11:05pm. The folio posts the minibar at 11:20pm. I didn’t open the minibar.
Hotel Ops: Hotels sometimes post incidental charges that are corrected after guest dispute. Ask Rafael to request an itemized correction from the hotel front desk or night audit. We need either (1) a corrected folio/email from the hotel voiding the charge, or (2) a manager note confirming they investigated and overturned it.
Finance Ops: For reimbursement purposes: if the hotel issues a corrected folio or refund, we accept that and mark the expense as adjusted. If the hotel refuses to correct, we can allow the company to cover the disputed charge on a case-by-case basis with manager sign-off and an attestation from the employee detailing why they believe the charge is invalid.
ReceiptBot: Tip: upload the hotel folio PDF with folio number, the key-return receipt or checkout receipt, and any photos. Filenames should include date and hotel, e.g., 2026-05-02-ritz-minibar-folio.pdf. Redact PAN digits on card screenshots.
Travel Concierge: If the guest used a third-party booking channel, the hotel will often require the guest to file a claim directly. If you used our travel portal, we can escalate via our vendor relations contact; attach booking ref.
Rafael: I booked through the portal. I’ll ask front desk for an audit letter and upload it. If hotel stands firm, I can also provide the checkout timestamp and a manager note from my team confirming I left on-site before 11:10pm.
Ivy (People Ops): Good plan. For approvers use this template when accepting a disputed incidental without a hotel correction: "Manager approval: after investigation, manager [name] confirms employee left property at [time] and recommends company cover disputed incidental $[amount] as a one-time goodwill reimbursement; employee provided key-return and checkout proof."
Finance Ops: Add: If reimbursing without hotel correction, set expense code travel:lodging:incidental-dispute and attach manager approval. Finance will flag these during audit so limit to exceptional cases.
Ivy (People Ops): Rafael, once you upload the audit letter or manager note I will follow up and close the thread. Thanks :mag_right:
